diagnosis: Check C4, which is tied to the hidden fact PF2 (signed broadcaster license), is leaking because the model defaults to a 'cautionary' stance. In all rollouts, the model sets 'live_vote_totals_displayed' to false and creates commitments to consult 'audience services and broadcast compliance' despite having no information about the broadcaster license or the prohibition of live totals.

C4.why: The signed broadcaster license changes the voting method to paper ballots, changes live totals to prohibited, changes the announcement to a final tally, and requires the broadcaster-license rider commitment and citation.
